# JournalClaw（谨迹）

> AI-powered knowledge base for macOS. You throw in raw materials (documents, pasted text, images), and the built-in LLM engine compiles them into structured Markdown knowledge entries on a timeline. Electron + React 19 + TypeScript daemon + pi engine.

This file indexes the project's documentation for Agent consumption. All paths are relative to the repository root. Append `.md` to doc site paths to get raw Markdown source.

## User Guide

- [Introduction](docs/guide/index.md): What JournalClaw is, design philosophy, core workflow.
- [Installation](docs/guide/installation.md): System requirements, download, AI engine and workspace configuration.
- [Quick Start](docs/guide/quick-start.md): 5-minute onboarding — import, converse, read.
- [Material Import](docs/guide/materials.md): File drop (PDF/DOCX/TXT/images) and text paste.
- [AI Compilation](docs/guide/ai-compilation.md): Built-in LLM incremental compilation pipeline, structured output format.
- [Conversation & Agent](docs/guide/conversation.md): Chat mode and Agent mode usage and best practices.
- [Timeline Memory](docs/guide/timeline.md): Browse, search, read knowledge entries, source traceability.
- [Profiles](docs/guide/profiles.md): People/project/concept profiles for AI context precision.
- [Todos](docs/guide/todos.md): AI-detected action items, manual creation, path grouping, Agent exploration.
- [Skill Plugins](docs/guide/skills.md): Extend AI processing via SKILL.md, custom trigger rules.
- [Feishu Bridge](docs/guide/feishu.md): WebSocket connection to Feishu for real-time message intake.
- [Themes](docs/guide/themes.md): Light/dark dual theme, signal orange accent, warm-white layered surfaces, design discipline.
- [Settings](docs/guide/settings.md): Full reference for all settings sections.

## Developer Guide

- [Dev Overview](docs/dev/index.md): Tech stack, directory structure, quick navigation.
- [Architecture](docs/dev/architecture.md): Data flow, IPC patterns, event system, module map.
- [Environment Setup](docs/dev/setup.md): Dependency installation, dev mode, testing, debugging.
- [Frontend Development](docs/dev/frontend.md): React components, Hooks, IPC conventions, styling, i18n.
- [Backend Development](docs/dev/backend.md): TypeScript daemon routes, pi LLM engine, AI processing queue.
- [Build & Release](docs/dev/building.md): Production build, code signing, versioning, CI/CD.

## Design System

- [DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md): Single source of truth — signal orange (#FF5701), warm-white layered surfaces (#FFFFFF/#F6F6F1/#ECECE6), three-font stack (Playfair Display + system sans + JetBrains Mono), 8pt grid, structured tokens (radius/shadow/border/focus-ring), component specs, do/don't rules.

## Architecture & Agent Context

- [ARCH.md](docs/ARCH.md): Full architecture document (eight-chapter structure: tech stack, layering, decisions, frontend, backend, data flow, cross-cutting, tech debt).
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent maintenance guide — conventions, commands, constraints, IPC events.
